page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6.8xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual server configured with 32 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture. Operating on the KVM hypervisor, the instance is powered by Intel Xeon 8269CY processors running at a base clock frequency of 2.5 GHz. The platform is provisioned with 256 GB of system memory, establishing a generous memory allocation ratio of 8.0 GB per dedicated vCPU core to support data-heavy operations.

Networking and storage interfaces on the instance are oriented around external network infrastructure. The configuration provides a baseline network throughput of 10 Gbps, while omitting complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Local storage is not included on the physical host, which requires the attachment of remote network storage volumes for operating systems and persistence. Additionally, the instance contains no dedicated GPU hardware acceleration units.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high RAM-to-vCPU density enables organizations to run large in-memory workloads without provisioning excess compute cores. The architecture is well matched for memory-constrained deployments, including in-memory databases, large-scale caching services, distributed big data analytics, and memory-intensive enterprise software.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6.8xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual server running on the KVM hypervisor with 32 dedicated vCPUs and 256 GB of system memory. Powered by 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processors on the x86_64 architecture, this instance establishes an 8 GB per vCPU memory ratio suitable for memory-intensive computations. The configuration offers 10 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. It contains no onboard local storage, necessitating reliance on networked storage solutions for disk operations, and includes no discrete GPU hardware accelerators. By delivering a dense memory footprint paired with dedicated vCPU allocations, the instance provides qualitative resource efficiency for setups where memory capacity is the primary constraint over compute or graphics processing. Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6.8xlarge is suited for in-memory databases such as Redis, enterprise-scale caching layers, in-memory data analytics pipelines, and large-footprint business backend applications.
